text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - USDA said private exporters reported sales of 105,000 tonnes of corn to unknown for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

CORN/SOY TENDER - Taiwan is likely to tender for up to 128,000 tonnes of corn this week along with a small cargo of 10,000 tonnes of soybeans after futures prices on the Chicago Board of Trade rose last week, traders said on Monday.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq, about to resume crude oil sales in an oil-for-food deal with the U.N., tendered on Friday to buy up to 100,000 tonnes of French wheat, grain traders said. The wheat is for shipment in September or October.
- The CCC said it was seeking on August 12, up to 30,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better soft white wheat for donation to Pakistan. Shipment period was slated for Nov 1-30.

- Morocco, which earlier postponed a tender for up to 130,000 tonnes of soft wheat, re-entered the grain market with a tender to import 90,000 tonnes, European grain traders said. Results of the tender are due on August 12.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender on August 11 for 27,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for donation to Eritrea. The shipment is August 24-September 13.
- Jordan is tendering on August 12 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.

VEGOIL TENDERS - El Salvador was seeking approximately 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,500 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title 1 export program, its U.S. export agent said. Both commodities were slated for October 1-15 shipment. Offers were due on August 14.

- Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19, 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be available on Sept 8.

MARKET TALK - A vessel arrived in Brazil's key port of Santos on Friday to take on the largest single cargo ever loaded at the port, a spokeswoman for the port authority CODESP said. The Aghia Trias was scheduled to load a total of 79,700 tonnes of soymeal and citrus meal at the public terminal and two private terminals.
It will load 11,000 tonnes soymeal and 33,000 citrus meal at the CODESP quays, in addition to 12,000 tonnes soymeal at the Cargill terminal and 23,900 tonnes citrus meal at Cutrale's terminal.
